integrity: Analytical proof is self-contained in RESULT.md. A standard-library exact-rational checker corroborates finite identities only. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem addresses only S2 membership of pairwise ordinary Cesàro-coordinate commutators on finite-dimensional Drury–Arveson spaces. Larger Schatten classes and compactness for dimensions >=6 are not classified. Closest Pilla full manuscripts were inaccessible for complete bibliographic comparison.
source_ids: Fang–Xia, Commutators and Localization on the Drury–Arveson Space, https://www.acsu.buffalo.edu/~jxia/Preprints/commutator.pdf
title: A dimension-five Hilbert–Schmidt cutoff for Drury–Arveson Cesàro commutators
